key_observations: The National Hurricane Center report places Ian's Cayo Costa, Florida landfall on September 28, 2022, at Category 4 intensity with estimated 130 kt sustained winds.
NOAA/NESDIS and NHC reporting support a southwest Florida wind-and-surge fact pattern, including reported inundation up to 12 to 18 feet above ground along the southwest Florida coast.
The NWS post-tropical cyclone report describes Ian's Cayo Costa landfall in Lee County and significant to devastating storm surge affecting the Charlotte, Lee, and Collier Gulf coasts.
